change_scope: Only skill sections 2 (component) and 4 (similar links). Reuse their exact already-tested conservative-linking candidate wording, combined with the adopted reproduction section. No new golden-derived hint or case-specific rule; no runtime script, template, hint, workflow, tool or permission changes.
candidate_section_source: evals/conservative-linking/policies/candidate-SKILL.md sections 2 and 4, preserved from the earlier rejected experiment; its original outcome remains unchanged.
case_design: 12 unused Q2 historical opening inputs, four per month with random seed4672028, excluding all prior case inputs; 12 separate independently authored constructed boundaries and positive/negative controls. Expectations and independent annotation review precede execution.
execution: 96 fresh first decisions in sixteen anonymous six-case sessions, each fresh without parent history and assigned one arm/repetition. Same case order across arms within a repeat. Eight separate known-case first decisions in four anonymous sessions (two cases each). No expected outcomes, previous outputs or Git history in runner contexts.
decision_rule: All planned first decisions are present, valid and sealed before scoring; candidate checks and label/comment validation must precede its first final decisions.

In each fresh and known case/repetition pair, candidate weighted error cost must not increase, a case pass must not be lost, and no new frozen-scorer failure category, safety error, invalid proposal or procedure violation is permitted.

Candidate required-action omissions and unsupported references must not increase in any pair. Designated positive link/component controls must retain their required actions in both candidate repetitions.
Both known cases e52255 and e53734 must pass their original unchanged frozen expectations in both candidate repetitions; these are separate development-informed checks, not fresh cases.

There must be at least one strict paired cost improvement over the current policy in the fresh or known checks. Report known and fresh gains separately; a known-only gain does not show broader accuracy improvement.
Independent blind review must find no harmful regression among changed optional actions or other unscored behavior; a rubric tie alone is not enough.

Adopt, commit and push only if every gate passes. Otherwise retain active runtime unchanged and save the rejected experiment locally without committing or pushing. No adaptive policy edits, repeats or expectation changes to seek a pass.
scoring: Use unchanged frozen score_run from commit4baa2cb. Separate historical, constructed and known cohorts. Report every paired action difference, optional choices, omissions, validations and failed gates. Predeclared supplemental gates do not alter frozen scores.
independence_limits: Coordinator knows the two failures and selected the previously tested general policy accordingly; known cases are not holdouts. AI annotations and review have required documentation context exposure. Runner contexts minimize exposure but do not enforce full filesystem isolation. Shared batch context and repetitions are correlated.
preservation: Preserve every earlier tracked file and evaluation result, including failed live/free results and previous rejected/adopted experiments. Snapshot prior raw worktree hashes before any runtime adoption. Use new namespace and exclusive writes.
cost: Existing Codex assistant access only; exact inherited backend identity/metered usage unavailable. No Anthropic or other provider API calls, paid hosted evaluations, workflow dispatches, credit purchase or external triage writes. Git commit/push only if accepted; this triggers offline CI only.
interpretation: Evidence can support no observed regression in these trials, never a guarantee that nothing can get worse on any future case. It does not retest configured Claude or hosted safeguards, and the separate90-run plan remains pending.
